sentences.text: Isfjordosaurus is an extinct genus of marine reptile belonging to the superorder Ichthyopterygia and the parent group Ichthyosauria. It is classified within the class Reptilia.
The genus contains only one known species, Isfjordosaurus minor.
Fossils of Isfjordosaurus have been found on the island of Spitsbergen in the Svalbard archipelago off northern Norway.
The genus was formally described by Ryosuke Motani in 1999.
This animal lived during the Early Triassic period.
